title: Data and code for: Weathered Bedrock Controls Stormflow, Baseflow, and Recharge While Limiting Hydrologic Memory
description: Analysis notebooks, processed hydrologic datasets, and generated figure outputs accompanying a manuscript on weathered-bedrock groundwater, stormflow, baseflow, recharge activation, and hydrologic memory at the Rivendell hillslope in the Elder Creek watershed, northern California.
